title: shipped some infrastructure today
summary:
- spores & seeds now get hourly pollen drips via cloudflare cron
- fixed nanobanana generation (vertex ai had invalid image sizes)
- bumped tinybird limits so the models page stopped jumping around

highlights.title: Hourly Pollen Refills
highlights.text: Spore and Seed tier balances now regenerate every hour. Your free tier credits grow back naturally while you figure out why your code isn't working.

highlights.title: Full Model Roster
highlights.text: The [models table](https://hello.pollinations.ai) now correctly fetches stats for all 200+ available models instead of giving up at 50. We also cleaned up the UI so you can easily spot new and alpha models.

highlights.title: Nanobanana Image Sizes
highlights.text: Requesting smaller images from nanobanana models now returns actual pixels instead of Vertex AI errors.
